record.paper_title: The cosmological constant, dark matter, supersymmetry, and other unsolved problems from a fresh perspective
record.original_question: What is the nature of dark energy in a framework that seeks to extend the standard models of particle physics and cosmology?

evidence.quote: Examples are the origin of Yukawa couplings, the origin of the Higgs boson mass, the nature of dark energy, an inflation-like mechanism in the early universe

artifact.self_contained_problem: In the framework of modern theoretical physics, the standard model of particle physics describes the known elementary particles and their interactions via the gauge group SU(3)×SU(2)×U(1), while the standard model of cosmology (ΛCDM) describes the large-scale evolution of the universe via Einstein's field equations with a cosmological constant Λ and a cold dark matter component. Observations indicate that approximately 70% of the energy density of the present universe behaves as a component with negative pressure driving accelerated cosmic expansion, conventionally modeled either by a cosmological constant Λ in Einstein's equations or by a dynamical field (e.g. quintessence). Identify the fundamental physical nature and theoretical origin of this dark energy component, and provide a derivation, within an extension of the standard models of particle physics and cosmology, that explains both its existence and its observed energy density scale.
artifact.status_search_result: The nature of dark energy remains one of the major unsolved problems of fundamental physics and cosmology. No widely accepted derivation of its origin or magnitude exists; ongoing experimental programs (DESI, Euclid) and theoretical proposals continue, with recent DESI results (2024–2025) suggesting possible evolution of the dark energy equation of state but no settled theoretical explanation.

status_evidence.title: Dark energy - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: The nature of dark energy is more hypothetical than that of dark matter, and many things about it remain in the realm of speculation.
status_evidence.claim: The nature of dark energy is an unresolved open problem.

status_evidence.title: DESI 2024 results on dark energy
status_evidence.snippet: DESI measurements hint that dark energy may be evolving over time, challenging the cosmological-constant interpretation.
status_evidence.claim: Recent observational results have not resolved the theoretical nature of dark energy.
